data.long_meaning: The name Gwenneth is derived from the Welsh word gwen, which means 'white, fair, blessed'. It is also believed to have connections to the Welsh word gwenwyn, meaning 'fair, blessed, smooth, white, or young'. The name Gwenneth carries the meaning “White, fair, blessed” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gwenneth usually hope their child will grow to embody white, fair, blessed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
